question: How does praising iḍā in the bindu method bring swift removal of obstacles?
premises: iḍā is praised in the bindu method
A request is made for removal
The removal is asked to happen quickly
inference: Praise of iḍā within the bindu method is invoked to remove obstacles swiftly.
uncertainties: The exact obstacle to be removed is unspecified
plain_english: Oh, in the method of the bindu I praise iḍā; may she quickly remove obstacles.
